basicDetails.schemeName: Theka Shramik, Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Evan Hamal Shramik Prasuti Sahayta Yojana

children.text: Applicant(Male or Female) must be registered worker.
Benefits will be provided only for two children.

eligibilityCriteria.eligibilityDescription_md:
1. Applicant(Male or Female) must be registered worker.
1. Benefits will be provided only for two children.

children.text: Female employees will receive a financial assistance of ₹4,200 in the third month of pregnancy and ₹2,800 in the eighth month of pregnancy as maternity benefit.
Male employees will receive a financial assistance of ₹3,000 as paternity leave after the birth of the child.

schemeContent.benefits_md:
- Female employees will receive a financial assistance of ₹4,200 in the third month of pregnancy and ₹2,800 in the eighth month of pregnancy as maternity benefit.
- Male employees will receive a financial assistance of ₹3,000 as paternity leave after the birth of the child.
schemeContent.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Theka Shramik, Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Evan Hamal Shramik Prasuti Sahayta Yojana" for unorganized worker on 11 March 2015.

children.text: Labor Department of Chhattisgarh State started this scheme "Theka Shramik, Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Evan Hamal Shramik Prasuti Sahayta Yojana" for unorganized worker on 05 June 2018. The main objective of the scheme to provide pregnancy care.
